en: Namaste 🙏 The Prasad box is dispatched after puja completes and usually reaches your registered address in 8–10 days — only if you selected Prasad at booking. Updates come on WhatsApp from {{PUJA_UPDATES_SENDER}}. For your booking status, share Order ID or open the order in app.
hi: Namaste 🙏 Puja complete hone ke baad Prasad box bheja jata hai aur aam taur par 8–10 din mein registered address par pahunchta hai — sirf tab jab booking par Prasad select kiya ho. Updates {{PUJA_UPDATES_SENDER}} se WhatsApp par aate hain.

en: Namaste 🙏 If Prasad was not selected at booking (and the ₹251 add-on was not paid), we cannot dispatch a box for that order. Please choose Prasad on your next puja booking if you would like delivery 🙏
hi: Namaste 🙏 Agar booking par Prasad select nahi tha (₹251 add-on nahi hua), to is order par box nahi bheja ja sakta. Agli booking par Prasad option choose kar sakte hain 🙏

en: Namaste 🙏 If Prasad was not selected at booking, we may add it manually only while the puja booking window is still open (add-on ₹251). Say “human agent” with your Order ID — we will check and share payment steps if possible.
hi: Namaste 🙏 Agar booking window abhi khuli hai to team ₹251 add-on ke saath Prasad manually add kar sakti hai. Order ID ke saath “human agent” likhein — hum check karenge.

en: Namaste 🙏 Items are blessed during puja — use with devotion (items vary by puja): Panchmeva — eat or share reverently; Rudraksha — home temple or wear after simple puja; Gangajal — sprinkle at home or in daily puja; Kalava — tie while praying; Kumkum / Bhasma — forehead or home puja as per your tradition 🙏
hi: Namaste 🙏 Prasad vastu puja mein bless hoti hain — shraddha se use karein (puja ke hisaab se alag ho sakta hai): Panchmeva — khayein/share karein; Rudraksha — mandir ya pehen sakte hain; Gangajal — ghar mein; Kalava — haath par bandhein; Kumkum/Bhasma — tradition ke mutabik 🙏

en: Namaste 🙏 We are sorry the Prasad box arrived damaged. Please share a clear photo of the package. Our team will check it with the courier and tell you the next step. This chat cannot promise a replacement — say “human agent” and send the photo. 🙏
hi: Namaste 🙏 Prasad box damage ke liye maafi. Package ki clear photo bhejein. Team courier se check karke agla step batayegi. Yahan replacement ka promise nahi — photo ke saath “human agent” likhein. 🙏

en: Currently we deliver Prasad only within India. The puja’s spiritual benefit and your video are still shared with you wherever you are 🙏
hi: Abhi Prasad sirf India ke andar deliver hota hai. Puja aur video aapko kahin se bhi share ki jaati hai 🙏

en: Prasad delivery address can be changed only before the box is dispatched. Once dispatched, we cannot change it. Say “human agent” with Order ID — we will check dispatch status and help if still possible 😊
hi: Prasad address tabhi badal sakte hain jab box dispatch nahi hua ho. Dispatch ke baad change nahi hota. Order ID ke saath “human agent” likhein — status check karenge.

en: Namaste 🙏 Sometimes Prasad is temporarily unavailable from the temple for a specific puja — we cannot offer it until availability returns. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience 🙏
hi: Namaste 🙏 Kabhi-kabhi mandir ki taraf se kisi puja ke liye Prasad temporarily unavailable hota hai — tab hum provide nahi kar paate. Asuvidha ke liye maafi 🙏

en: We pack dry items such as Panchmeva for safer transit (typically 8–10 days). Prasad is prepared and packed with care and devotion 🙏
hi: Transit ke liye dry items jaise Panchmeva pack karte hain (8–10 din). Prasad care aur shraddha se taiyar hota hai 🙏

en: Contents vary by puja. Common items: Thank You card, Panchmeva, Kalawa, Gangajal, Kumkum or Bhasma, and sometimes Rudraksha, Morpankh, or murti (e.g. Santan/Baal Gopal pujas). Exact list matches your booked puja — check your booking summary or ask “human agent” if unsure 🙏
hi: Prasad box puja ke hisaab se alag hota hai. Aam cheezen: Thank You card, Panchmeva, Kalawa, Gangajal, Kumkum/Bhasma, kabhi Rudraksha/Morpankh/murti. Booking summary par dekhein ya “human agent” se confirm karein 🙏
